title: 3.4.20 Chart the Code: Full Syntax-Forms Comparison
description: Chart one operation walking through all three function forms, so the piece each form adds or drops — name, return, parens — is visible side by side.

aiGrader.prompt: This chart is scored entirely by rules from its shapes and arrows. No model reads it.

rubric.title: Naming first, then braces
rubric.description: Scored by the editor (arrow order): one decision comes before another on the route.

steps.fail: The comparison asks two questions in order: is the function named, then does the body use braces. Draw the second diamond after the first.
steps.pass: The second question follows the first.

rubric.title: One task for each form
rubric.description: Scored by the editor (shape kind): at least three task rectangles.

steps.fail: Draw a task rectangle for each of the three forms.
steps.pass: There is a task for each form.

rubric.title: All three forms reach the print
rubric.description: Scored by the editor: an input/output step for the print, which comes after the decisions.

steps.fail: The three forms are one choice made three times, so they should all lead to one print. Draw an input/output step for the print.
Every route has to pass a decision and then the print before End: one of your forms skips the print.
steps.pass: Every route passes the decisions, then the print, then End.

gate.fail: None of your shapes say what this program does. Label each shape in your own words.
